translations.web: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches;
translations.bsb: All the birds of the air nested on its fallen trunk, and all the beasts of the field lived among its boughs.
translations.kjv: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:
translations.asv: Upon his ruin all the birds of the heavens shall dwell, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches;
